events.title: Natya Tharanga — Classical & Semi-Classical Solo Dance
events.description: A celebration of rhythm, expressiveness, and timeless Indian dance heritage. Showcase classical traditions (Bharatanatyam, Kuchipudi, Kathak) or semi-classical innovations with intricate footwork and abhinaya.
rules: Maximum performance duration is 6 minutes (including stage setup).
Accompaniment tracks must be submitted 2 hours prior to the event in MP3/WAV format.
Classical props are permitted; fire, water, or hazardous items strictly prohibited.
Judging criteria: Rhythm (Talam), Expression (Abhinaya), Choreography, and Stage Presence.
events.eligibility: Open to bonafide college students with valid College ID.

events.title: Step Synchro — Western & Street Crew Dance Battle
events.description: The premier national street dance showdown. Bring your squad to electrify the Open Air Theatre with synchronised power moves, locking, popping, hip-hop, and urban fusion choreography.
rules: Team strength: 6 to 18 dancers.
Performance duration: 8 to 10 minutes.
Costumes must be dignified and suitable for an inter-college arena.
Props allowed upon prior inspection by event coordinators.
events.eligibility: Inter-collegiate crew teams. Cross-college crews not permitted.

events.title: Swaralaya — Light Music & Classical Vocal Solo
events.description: A melodic quest for the finest collegiate vocalists. Contestants perform soulful Indian film compositions, light music, or semi-classical melodies accompanied by live acoustic tracks.
rules: Time limit: 4 minutes per participant.
Karaoke track or single acoustic instrument accompaniment permitted.
Judging: Pitch (Shruti), Rhythm (Laya), Vocal Dynamics, and Emotional Resonance.
events.eligibility: Individual undergraduate and postgraduate students.
events.coordinatorName: Dr. G. Radhika & V. Sai Teja

events.title: Battle of the Bands — Collegiate Rock & Fusion
events.description: The thunderous pinnacle of musical competition. College bands unleash acoustic harmonies, rock anthems, or progressive Indian fusion in an unadulterated live sound arena.
rules: Band size: 3 to 8 members.
Stage time: 15 minutes setup + 15 minutes live performance.
Standard 5-piece drum kit and amplifiers provided; personal guitars/processors required.
Original compositions score bonus points in evaluation.
events.eligibility: Registered college band lineups.

events.title: Chitra Varna — Thematic Live Painting & Fine Arts
events.description: Live art spectacle on custom canvases. Artists express the theme revealed at commencement through acrylic, oil, charcoal, or mixed media textures.
rules: Drawing sheet provided; participants must bring their own colors and brushes.
Duration: 2.5 hours.
Mobile phones and reference imagery strictly prohibited during contest.
events.eligibility: Individual students.

events.title: Colorido Super League — Turf & Box Cricket Championship
events.description: The high-octane 8-over collegiate cricket tournament. Lightning fast bowling, strategic fielding powerplays, and boundary-blasting batsmanship under international tournament regulations.
rules: Squad: 8 playing + 2 substitutes.
8 overs per innings; maximum 2 overs per bowler.
Strict adherence to ICC white-ball rules adapted for collegiate turf.
Official umpires decisions are final and binding.
events.eligibility: Recognized collegiate athletic teams with institutional recommendation.
events.coordinatorName: Physical Director Dr. P. Ramesh & B. Tarun

events.title: Invictus Football Cup — 7-A-Side Inter-Collegiate
events.description: Pace, precision, and passion collide on the lush green pitch. Fast-break counter-attacks and tactical possession warfare in an exhilarating 7-a-side format.
rules: Match duration: 20 minutes each half with 5 minutes halftime.
Squad: 7 players on field + up to 4 rolling substitutions.
FIFA standard fouls and yellow/red card disciplinary code enforced.
Tied knockout games proceed straight to penalty shootouts (5 kicks).
events.eligibility: Men & Women collegiate squads with full kit.

events.title: Slam Dunk Basketball Championship — 5v5 Hardcourt
events.description: High-flying dunks, precision 3-pointers, and relentless court defense under the floodlights at the outdoor synthetic basketball complex.
rules: Four quarters of 8 minutes stop-clock play.
FIBA standard regulations regarding fouls and timeouts.
Matching collegiate jerseys with visible player numbers mandatory.
events.eligibility: Collegiate teams (Separate brackets for Men and Women).

events.title: Grandmaster Rapid Chess Open — FIDE Swiss System
events.description: Intense mental warfare across 64 squares. 5-round Swiss format with digital clocks, testing tactical acumen, deep calculation, and endgame mastery.
rules: Time control: 15 minutes + 5 seconds increment from move 1.
Touch-move rule strictly observed.
Tiebreaks: Buchholz, Sonnenborn-Berger, Direct Encounter.
events.eligibility: Individual collegiate chess players.
events.coordinatorName: Prof. Y. Nageswara Rao & M. Harsha

events.title: Shuttle Surge — Men & Women Badminton Doubles
events.description: Lightning reflex smashes and deceptive drop shots on synthetic badminton courts with BWF standards.
rules: BWF 21-point rally scoring system, best of 3 games.
Yonex Mavis 350 shuttles provided for all tournament matches.
Non-marking badminton shoes mandatory for court entry.
events.eligibility: Doubles pairs from the same college institution.

events.title: Hack-a-Colore — 24-Hour AI & Web3 Codeathon
events.description: Official notice: This technical event has been rescheduled and postponed to 9 October 2026 to ensure synchronized national participation.
rules: Details will be officially updated on the technical symposium announcement portal.
events.eligibility: Engineers & Tech students.

events.title: Choreoday — Theme-Based Group Choreography Showdown
events.description: The monumental theme-based theatrical choreography showcase of COLORIDO 2K26. Troupes present narrative visual storytelling blending classical, folk, and contemporary styles under an evocative conceptual theme.
rules: Team strength: 8 to 24 dancers per collegiate squad.
Performance duration: 10 to 12 minutes (including intro and clearance).
Original thematic concept synopsis must be submitted at registration desk.
Props allowed upon prior safety check (no pyrotechnics or fluids).
events.eligibility: Official college choreography troupes with faculty coordinator authorization.

events.title: Rangmanch — One-Act Play & Street Theatrics
events.description: Powerful social commentary, satirical wit, and dramatic intensity on stage and street circles. Bring alive scripts addressing contemporary culture, ethics, and youth aspirations.
rules: Team size: 6 to 15 performers.
Time duration: 12 to 15 minutes.
Languages permitted: English, Telugu, Hindi.
Judging based on script originality, voice projection, timing, and thematic impact.
events.eligibility: Collegiate dramatics societies and stage clubs.

events.title: Vogue Glamour — Haute Couture & Ethnic Fusion Runway
events.description: Elegance, poise, and visionary costume aesthetics. Teams showcase high-fashion narratives celebrating Indian heritage handlooms or futuristic couture with synchronized music and ramps.
rules: Team size: 10 to 18 models plus styling crew.
Ramp time: 10 minutes maximum.
Themes must uphold decency and inter-collegiate decorum.
Soundtracks must be submitted in uncompressed WAV format.
events.eligibility: Inter-collegiate fashion clubs.

events.title: Tekraft Spotlight — Digital Short Film & Creative Tech Media
events.description: Where artistic cinematography meets modern digital engineering. Showcase 3 to 7 minute original short films, VFX visual experiments, or motion design masterpieces.
rules: Team size: 1 to 5 creators.
Film duration: 3 to 7 minutes including titles and credits.
Submissions must be 1080p MP4 with original audio or copyright-cleared scores.
Judging: Storytelling, cinematography, sound design, and technical editing.
events.eligibility: Open to bonafide college students across all disciplines.
events.coordinatorName: Dr. G. Koteswara Rao & P. Divya

events.title: Akshara — Inter-Collegiate Debate, Elocution & Creative Writing
events.description: A battle of orators and literary intellectuals. Test eloquence, persuasive rhetoric, and creative writing prowess on compelling national and cultural topics.
rules: Individual or 2-member debate duos.
Debate format: Parliamentary style (3 mins speech + 1 min rebuttal).
Elocution topics announced 1 hour prior to session.
Strict adherence to parliamentary language and decorum.
events.eligibility: Undergraduate and postgraduate students with college ID.

events.title: Spike Storm — Boys Volleyball Championship
events.description: Electric spikes, disciplined blocks, and precision setting. The premier inter-collegiate men volleyball tournament under official FIVB regulations.
rules: FIVB rules: Best of 3 sets for league stage; Best of 5 for finals.
Team roster: 6 playing + 6 substitutes (including libero).
Proper team jerseys with clear front and back numbering mandatory.
events.eligibility: Bonafide male collegiate students with institution authorization.

events.title: Spin Master — Boys Table Tennis Championship
events.description: Blazing top-spins, deceptive chops, and lightning counter-attacks. Boys singles and team format on ITTF certified Stiga competition tables.
rules: ITTF 11-point best-of-5 games knockout system.
ITTF approved 3-star 40+ white plastic balls provided.
Rackets must have authorized red and black rubbers.
events.eligibility: Men students from recognized colleges.
events.coordinatorName: Coach N. Srinivasa Rao & G. Srikanth

events.title: Aura Strike — Girls Throwball Championship
events.description: Speed, aerial coordination, and team cohesion. The premier women collegiate throwball championship hosted on professional outdoor courts.
rules: World Throwball Federation rules apply.
Squad: 7 playing + 5 substitutes.
Matches played as best of 3 sets of 25 points.
Ball must be released within 3 seconds of catch.
events.eligibility: Women collegiate squads with institutional authorization.

events.title: Ring Velocity — Girls TenniKoit Championship
events.description: Rapid reflexes, wrist agility, and deceptive ring placement over the net. Singles and doubles formats for collegiate women athletes.
rules: TenniKoit Federation of India rules apply.
Best of 3 sets of 21 points.
Smooth, continuous ring catch and delivery without body touch.
Foot fault and carry violations strictly monitored.
events.eligibility: Women students from recognized universities and colleges.

events.title: Rapid Smash — Girls Table Tennis Championship
events.description: Fierce rallies, angular drives, and razor-sharp returns. Women singles table tennis championship on tournament-grade tables.
rules: ITTF 11-point best-of-5 games knockout system.
Non-marking indoor sports shoes mandatory.
Official umpires rulings are final.
events.eligibility: Women college students with valid student ID.
events.coordinatorName: Coach N. Srinivasa Rao & L. Pooja

venues.name: Silver Jubilee Main Auditorium
venues.description: Acoustically engineered state-of-the-art 2,500-seat auditorium hosting flagship cultural performances, battle of bands, and inaugural ceremonies.
venues.directions: Central Campus Quadrangle, opposite Administrative Block

venues.name: Open Air Theatre (OAT)
venues.description: Vibrant 4,000-capacity amphitheatre with tier seating, expansive dynamic stage lighting, and natural acoustic projection.
venues.directions: East Campus, adjacent to Student Amenities Center

venues.name: Indoor Sports Arena
venues.description: Multi-sport indoor wooden parquet court equipped for national-level badminton, table tennis, and chess championships.

venues.name: Main Athletic Stadium & Turf Grounds
venues.description: Standard 400m 8-lane running track, lush green football pitch, and floodlit cricket turf arena for high-energy sporting battles.

venues.name: Student Activity Center (SAC)
venues.description: Creative studio complex, dance rehearsal mirrors, art exhibition galleries, and debate halls.

announcements.title: COLORIDO 2K26 Dates & Cultural + Sports Focus Confirmed
announcements.content: R.V.R. & J.C. College of Engineering proudly welcomes collegiate talent from across the country on 28 and 29 December 2026 for a monumental celebration of Cultural expression and Sports athleticism.

announcements.title: Technical Events Rescheduled to 9 October 2026
announcements.content: Please note that the technical symposium and codeathons have been postponed to 9 October 2026. The primary December 28–29 festival will focus entirely on Cultural Arts and Sports Championships.

announcements.title: Registration Portal is Now Officially Live
announcements.content: Inter-collegiate registration for all Cultural and Sports categories is now open. Participants from both RVR & JC CE and all other colleges can register and generate their instant digital passes.

faqs.question: When and where is COLORIDO 2K26 taking place?
faqs.answer: COLORIDO 2K26 will be hosted on December 28 and 29, 2026, on the sprawling 37-acre campus of R.V.R. & J.C. College of Engineering in Guntur, Andhra Pradesh, India.

faqs.question: What are the primary active domains for this edition of COLORIDO?
faqs.answer: This edition places spotlight on TWO WORLDS: CULTURAL and SPORTS. Technical symposium events have been postponed to 9 October.

faqs.question: Can students from other colleges participate in COLORIDO 2K26?
faqs.answer: Yes! Students from recognized universities and colleges nationwide are enthusiastically invited. Simply select "Other College" during online registration.

faqs.question: How do I obtain my entry pass or digital ticket?
faqs.answer: Once your registration is verified on the portal, an authentic digital ticket with a scannable QR verification code is instantly created. You can view, save, or print it anytime under "My COLORIDO".

faqs.question: What are the reporting and check-in procedures on festival days?
faqs.answer: Registration desks at the Central Quadrangle open at 08:00 AM on both Day 01 (Dec 28) and Day 02 (Dec 29). Present your digital QR pass and physical College ID for instantaneous check-in.

faqs.question: Is accommodation provided for outstation teams?
faqs.answer: Limited subsidized hostel accommodation is available on a first-come, first-served basis for verified outstation sports squads and cultural performing troupes upon prior intimation.

websiteChallenge.title: COLORIDO 2K26 — Official Website Design Challenge
websiteChallenge.subtitle: Design, Engineer & Deploy the Digital Soul of COLORIDO 2K26
websiteChallenge.description: Calling student developers, UI/UX innovators, and full-stack architects! The official COLORIDO 2K26 Website Design Challenge invites 2-member teams to craft an industry-grade web application covering Cultural and Sports events with live check-in, real-time analytics, and dual-world branding.
requirements: The website must cover BOTH Cultural and Sports events seamlessly.
Must be a complete functional digital platform, not only a landing page or static UI.
Include dynamic event exploration, intuitive registration flow, real-time schedule, and authentic digital pass system.
High visual aesthetics: Dual-world branding, fluid micro-interactions, responsive mobile-first architecture.
Performant code: Optimized assets, accessible color contrast, clean component architecture.
Submission repository URL and live deployed link must be provided by the deadline.
websiteChallenge.technologies: Modern Web Technologies (Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS)
